core_struggle: I keep comparing myself to others
mirror: You scroll through what everyone else is doing, and your own page feels like it is not enough.

queries.hook: The mind that will not settle, caught between the noise of others' success and the silence of your own effort.
queries.diagnose: When the mind runs after the noise of others, it becomes its own enemy; what is real in you cannot be found in any comparison.
queries.steady: Praise and blame come and go; what is yours to do is yours to do, and the self that does it is not in any of it.
queries.act: Practise giving your mind one quiet minute to settle; when it runs, bring it back to what is in front of you right now.
queries.story: A young student who could not settle, running after the noise of a world that seemed ahead, and the one thing that finally let her rest.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call a mind that won't settle, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: The restless mind that measures itself against others is the one that will learn to settle, by turning away from the noise and toward what is real.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the restlessness, and the noise that feeds it, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the mind is its own enemy when it runs after the noise of others' success.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you is not in any comparison, and that is what can settle you.
week_beats.act: You try giving your mind one quiet minute to settle, and bringing it back to what is in front of you.
week_beats.story: A young student who could not settle, running after the noise of a world that seemed ahead, shows you how rest begins.

insight: The praise your parents give does not reach the part of you that is fighting to pass. That part is not being seen.
details: others have internships and side startups
